# SeenBy Digital
> AI search visibility agency based in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia. We help Malaysian SME businesses get discovered, cited, and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — through a practice called Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). SeenBy Digital is not a traditional SEO agency; we specialize exclusively in AI search visibility.

## Services
- [Basic Retainer](https://www.seenby.my/#pricing): Monthly GEO optimization at RM 2,000/month. Includes AI search visibility optimization, website SEO audit and recommendations, content strategy and writing suggestions, social media visibility recommendations across LinkedIn, Reddit, Instagram, X, and Wikipedia, plus monthly monitoring and reporting.
- [Executive Retainer](https://www.seenby.my/#pricing): Full-service monthly GEO at RM 4,200/month. Includes everything in Basic plus full website SEO optimization and implementation, content writing up to 10 pages per month, and hands-on social media visibility execution across all five platforms.

## Key Facts
- Business name: SeenBy Digital (SSM registered, Malaysia)
- Founded by: Muhammad Faris Irfan, AI Engineer
- Location: Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- Industry: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search Visibility
- Core service: Monthly GEO retainer — AI search visibility optimization for Malaysian SMEs
- Target clients: Malaysian SMEs in healthcare, F&B, professional services, property, retail, and SaaS
- Pricing: RM 2,000/month (Basic); RM 4,200/month (Executive) — see website for current rates
- Not a traditional SEO agency — specializes exclusively in AI search visibility

## How It Works
- [How SeenBy Works](https://www.seenby.my/#how-it-works): Four-step process — 48-hour audit, scored priority fix list, implementation by SeenBy, and monthly monitoring with GEO score tracking.

## About
- [GEO Score Explained](https://www.seenby.my/#score): SeenBy's proprietary 5-dimension GEO Score (0–100) measuring AI search visibility across citability, brand authority, content quality, technical foundations, and structured data.
